title: Top Ten Songs to Take a Crap To
setup: Tonight’s playlist comes with its own listening booth.

entries.text: Carly Simon — Anticipation. We have all been here before.
The Kinks — Tired of Waiting for You. So is everyone outside.
U2 — Stuck in a Moment You Can’t Get Out Of. A concept album, apparently.
The House at Pooh Corner. Location, location, location.
Buzzcocks — Oh Shit. Finally, an honest review.
Spinal Tap — Big Bottom. Turn the fan up to eleven.
The Clash — Cut the Crap. Management has requested a shorter set.
Salt-N-Pepa — Push It. No further notes.
Snoop Dogg — Drop It Like It’s Hot. Please remain seated.
Screamin’ Jay Hawkins — Constipation Blues. The residency has been extended.
